import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from harness import *
build()
def st(r): return [(p['level'],p['pn'],p['status']) for p in r['packets']]
def one(body, level='A', auth=None, **kw):
    ev = ([{'keys':['I','H','A']}] if level=='A' else []) + [datagram(envelope(level,0,body,**kw), auth=(0,) if level!='A' else (0,))]
    r = run1(ev, **kw) if False else run1(ev)
    return r

# empty payload
r = one(b'')
print('empty payload  ', st(r), r['closed'])
# unknown type
r = one(b'\x1f')
print('unknown 0x1f   ', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x32\x00')
print('unknown 0x32   ', st(r), r['closed'])
# nonminimal type encoding
r = one(b'\x40\x01')
print('nonminimal ping', st(r), r['closed'])
# server only frames
r = one(b'\x07\x01\xaa')
print('new_token      ', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x1e')
print('handshake_done ', st(r), r['closed'])
# forbidden level: STREAM in Initial
r = one(b'\x08\x00\x00', level='I')
print('stream in I    ', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x1d\x00\x00', level='I')
print('app close in I ', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x1c\x00\x00\x00', level='I')
print('trans close in I', st(r), r['closed'], r['packets'][0]['sha256'] is not None)
# truncated body
r = one(b'\x06\x00')
print('crypto trunc   ', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x06\x00\x05abc')
print('crypto data short', st(r), r['closed'])
r = one(b'\x02\x00')
print('ack trunc      ', st(r), r['closed'])
# ping/padding ok in all levels
r = one(b'\x00\x00\x01\x00', level='H')
print('H pad/ping     ', st(r), r['packets'][0]['sha256'])
# crypto in initial
r = one(b'\x06\x00\x03abc', level='I')
print('I crypto       ', st(r), r['crypto'][0])
# first error wins: bad frame after good one
r = one(b'\x01' + b'\x1f')
print('first error    ', st(r), r['closed'])
EOF
python3 t03.py
